description: Look up a dream symbol (teeth, snake, pig, water, fire, ancestor, money, exam…) or a short dream sentence in Korean or English in The Korean Today dream dictionary (72 symbols): traditional Korean reading, a gentle psychological view, a tip for the day and a for-fun rating, with the symbol page URL. For entertainment only — dreams do not predict the future.
